about: s03: The pick card, the tap on Rajma chawal. Cue times are seconds from the shot's start. Hard cut to bright; the card and its two dishes cut in whole. The click (ref 786 to 798) lands on L02's second 'Rajma!' (0.76 s into the line, which starts at 0.1). The buttons fold into the vote one frame after the colour lands.
